f14297ceb49f7a3527a0e5115a9eaaf948d566b4.analysis:
### 1. Frontend Style Direction
* **Colors:** Primary blue header bar (~#2E7DB2 gradient); white surface (#FFFFFF); orange accent (~#E8820C) for helper text, links, and primary button; red (~#E02020) for required-field asterisks and password-strength bar; gray placeholder text (~#999); blue links (~#3B8CD4).
* **Typography:** System sans-serif (Chinese UI). Labels ~14–15px regular; placeholders ~14px gray; helper text ~13–14px orange; header title ~16–18px white bold.
* **Spacing Rhythm:** Medium; form rows ~55–60px vertical rhythm; generous left/right padding inside a full-width container; fields right-aligned label column, left-aligned inputs.
* **Overall Tone:** Classic Chinese government/enterprise service portal registration form — clean, utilitarian, high-clarity.

### 2. Page Skeleton (Top to Bottom)
* **Section: Page Card ("Account Info")**
  * **Purpose:** Single-step account registration form.
  * **Container:** Full-width card on white background, thin light-blue outer border, no shadow; top header bar with blue gradient, white title, small rounded top corners.
  * **Children (ordered):**
    1. **Header bar** – title text, white on blue gradient.
    2. **Required fields group** – 8 form rows: username, login password (with strength meter), confirm password, certificate type (select), name, certificate number, passenger discount type (select).
    3. **Dashed divider** – light gray horizontal dashed line separating required from optional group.
    4. **Optional/contact group** – email row; phone row (country-code select + number input + orange helper text).
    5. **Agreement row** – checkbox + agreement text with blue hyperlinks.
    6. **Submit area** – centered orange button.
  * **Style Notes:** Left-aligned label column with right-aligned labels; red asterisks prefix required labels; inline right-side helper text per row.

### 3. Data Presentation Style
* **Pattern Type:** Vertical label-input form (single column, centered block ~ middle of card).
* **Visual Structure:**
  * Each row: [required asterisk + label] → [input/select ~350–360px wide, 1px gray border, ~4px radius] → [optional orange helper text to the right].
  * Password row includes a 3-segment horizontal strength meter (red/yellow/green segments, gray when inactive).
  * Phone row: composite control — country-code dropdown (+86 style select) attached to a shorter number input.
* **Field Types:** text, password, dropdown selects, email, phone number, checkbox consent.
* **Styling Rules:** Inputs ~36–40px tall; placeholders gray; helper text inline, not stacked; label/asterisk color contrast is the main emphasis mechanism.
* **Do Not Copy Actual Values:** Render placeholders generically; do not seed with the screenshot's specific placeholder sentences.

### 4. Interaction Surfaces
* **Primary:** Orange "Next Step" button — solid orange, white text, ~4–6px radius, ~150–200px wide, centered, subtle gradient.
* **Secondary:** Text inputs and dropdowns (gray borders, white bg); password strength meter (visual feedback); agreement checkbox; blue inline hyperlinks (terms/privacy) opening dialogs or new pages.
* **Helper text** acts as validation/format guidance adjacent to relevant inputs.

### 5. Frontend Requirements Summary
* **Must Preserve:** Blue-gradient card header; label-right / input-left alignment with inline right-side orange hints; red asterisk convention; dashed divider between required and optional sections; composite phone input (country select + number); 3-segment password strength meter; centered orange CTA.
* **Runtime-Driven Areas:** Dropdown options (certificate types, discount types, country codes); password strength calculation; helper text driven by validation rules; link targets.
* **Avoid:** Hardcoding the screenshot's specific placeholder strings, agreement titles, or country/option values as fixed business data.

a0f460af25e38d3eb60632e1585f8db72683dfd9.analysis:
### 1. Frontend Style Direction
* **Colors:** Primary orange `#F2792A` (CTA button, logo accent); blue hero background `#4E7FE0`–`#6E9BE8` gradient/photo; white surfaces `#FFFFFF`; text dark gray `#333` / `#666`; link blue `#3B6ED0`; footer dark gray `#4A4A4A`.
* **Typography:** Chinese sans (system/Heiti-style). Header title ~20–24px bold; hero headline large (~40px) white, subline yellow-green; body/labels 14–16px; footer 13–14px light gray on dark.
* **Spacing Rhythm:** Spacious hero; medium density in login card; generous footer padding. Vertical rhythm ~16–24px gaps in forms.
* **Overall Tone:** Government/enterprise official service portal login page — trustworthy, clean, single-purpose CTA.

### 2. Page Skeleton (Top to Bottom)
* **Header Bar**
  * Purpose: brand identity + page title.
  * Container: full-width white bar, ~80px tall, no border/shadow.
  * Children: left logo (icon + bilingual brand text), page title “欢迎登录12306” adjacent.
  * Style Notes: logo orange; title bold dark gray.

* **Hero Section (Banner + Login)**
  * Purpose: marketing banner + login entry point.
  * Container: full-width blue photographic background (~55–60% viewport height), content centered within a wide max-width container, bottom edge has a curved white wave shape.
  * Children (two-column layout, roughly 2:1):
    1. **Left promo area:** large white headline + yellow subline; 2×2 grid of feature items with outlined checkbox-style icons + labels; bottom: QR code block (white QR tile + arrow + caption text).
    2. **Right login card:** white, slightly rounded (~4px), soft shadow, fixed ~380–420px wide; internally split into tabs area, form area, and a bottom info strip separated by divider, plus a light-blue footer note strip (business hours notice) in small gray text.
  * Style Notes: carousel dot indicator at bottom center of hero; card floats over hero, right-aligned.

* **Links / QR Footer Section**
  * Purpose: partner links and official channel QR codes.
  * Container: white full-width band, generous padding.
  * Children:
    1. Left column “友情链接” label + 2×2 grid of bordered link cards (logo + name, light gray border).
    2. Right area: row of four QR code columns each with a title above, plus a bordered notice card with small advisory text.
  * Style Notes: flat, minimal borders, muted logos.

* **Page Footer**
  * Purpose: copyright, legal/ICP filing info.
  * Container: full-width dark gray bar, centered light-gray text, two lines.
  * Children: copyright line; filing numbers row with separator pipes; accessibility badge (适老化/无障碍) right-aligned.
  * Style Notes: small type, low emphasis.

### 3. Data Presentation Style
* **Login Card Info Strip**
  * Pattern: static notice text block (small gray paragraph) on light tinted background.
  * Field types: service-hours / policy text; keep data-driven if localized.
* **Link Cards**
  * Pattern: bordered horizontal tiles, icon + name, 2-column grid.
* **QR Code Grid**
  * Pattern: repeated vertical items — title label + square QR image; uniform size and spacing.
* No tables/charts; page is form-centric. Do not copy partner names or filing numbers into seeded data.

### 4. Interaction Surfaces
* **Tabs (login card top):** two equal tabs — “账号登录” / “扫码登录”; active tab blue text with underline/indicator, inactive gray. This is the primary mode switcher (account login vs QR scan panel swap).
* **Text inputs:** two full-width fields (username/phone/email, password), light gray background `#F5F6F8`, ~4px radius, left inline gray icons, placeholder gray. Secondary visual weight.
* **Primary CTA:** full-width orange button, white bold label, ~6px radius, hover darkening.
* **Secondary links:** row below CTA — registration link (blue) | separator | forgot-password (gray). Small text.
* **QR login panel:** alternate tab content — QR code with refresh/scan instructions (implied by tabs).
* Footer accessibility toggle badge (accessible version entry).

### 5. Frontend Requirements Summary
* **Must Preserve:** blue hero with floating white login card on the right; two-tab login switcher; orange primary button as the only strong accent; curved hero bottom edge; 2×2 feature checklist on banner; QR/link footer grid; dark slim footer.
* **Runtime-Driven Areas:** login form state/validation, active tab content, notice text, partner links list, QR image sources.
* **Avoid:** hardcoding specific partner names, filing numbers, dates, or phone/credentials from the screenshot as data; banner content (headline, features, QR) should be configurable content, not baked-in logic.

c5e222d2e74465236941222fcbd7dfd50a2aca9d.analysis:
### 1. Frontend Style Direction
* **Colors:**
  * Primary: Railway blue `#3B99FC` / `#2E8AE6` (nav bar, tabs, icons, links)
  * Accent: Orange `#F5820B` / `#FF8800` (primary CTA, logo mark, highlights)
  * Surfaces: white `#FFFFFF` cards, light blue gradient banners (`#DFF1FB → #C6E6F8`)
  * Background: white page body; hero uses full-bleed photo with dark gradient overlay for text legibility
  * Text: dark gray `#333` headings, `#666/#999` secondary
* **Typography:** Clean sans-serif (PingFang / Microsoft YaHei style). Logo ~28px bold; nav ~16px; form labels ~15px; headings in promo cards ~24–28px bold; body ~14px. Medium-to-bold weights for emphasis.
* **Spacing Rhythm:** Medium-density portal layout. Content column ~1200px centered; generous horizontal gutters on hero; 16–24px gaps between grid cards; form padding ~20px.
* **Overall Tone:** Government/transportation consumer portal — friendly, trustworthy, functional; blue-dominant with orange CTA accents; illustration-heavy promo area.

### 2. Page Skeleton (Top to Bottom)
* **Top Header Bar**
  * **Purpose:** Branding, site search, account utilities.
  * **Container:** Full-width white bar, no border below (nav bar provides separation).
  * **Children:** Left: logo (orange train icon + bilingual wordmark) → Center: rounded-corner search input with blue square search button → Right: utility links row (accessibility, elderly version, language selector dropdown, user account dropdown, login/register).
  * **Style Notes:** Small text links separated by thin vertical dividers; dropdown caret icons on language/account items.
* **Primary Navigation Bar**
  * **Purpose:** Top-level section navigation.
  * **Container:** Full-width solid blue bar (~48–56px tall).
  * **Children:** Horizontal nav items, each with caret for dropdown menus; active item shown on darker/deeper blue background block.
  * **Style Notes:** White text ~16px, evenly spaced, active state = filled darker-blue rectangle, hover likely darkens item.
* **Hero / Booking Panel Section**
  * **Purpose:** Main ticket search entry point + marketing banner.
  * **Container:** Full-bleed carousel (banner image, ~500px tall) with dot pagination centered at bottom. Left vertical accent strip of gradient blue at page edge.
  * **Children:**
    * Floating white booking card (left-of-center, ~600px wide, slight shadow): internal left vertical tab rail (3 items: ticket search, frequent query, catering) with active tab solid blue; right area with top tab row (one-way / round-trip / transfer / refund-change), form fields (origin, destination with location icons, swap button between fields, date picker), two inline checkboxes, full-width orange submit button.
    * Right side: promotional overlay — large headline text, QR code card, supporting caption, phone mockup imagery.
  * **Style Notes:** White card radius ~4–8px; inputs bordered light gray with icon suffixes; circular orange swap button overlapping the two location fields; carousel dots small translucent circles.
* **Quick Service Icon Row**
  * **Purpose:** Entry links to auxiliary services.
  * **Container:** Centered horizontal flex row on white, ~80px tall icons.
  * **Children:** 7 icon+label items (passenger reservation, lost & found, car booking, luggage consignment, station guide, station showcase, user feedback), separated by faint diagonal slash dividers.
  * **Style Notes:** Flat blue filled icons ~48px, dark 14–15px labels below.
* **Promo Card Grid (2×2)**
  * **Purpose:** Feature/product marketing.
  * **Container:** Two-column grid, ~1200px centered, ~24px gaps; each card ~350–400px tall, rounded corners minimal.
  * **Children:** Each card: light blue gradient background, left-aligned title (bold blue ~26px), 2 lines of description, right-side illustration/imagery.
  * **Style Notes:** Soft pastel blue backgrounds varying slightly per card; illustrations (train, food plate, shield, phone) bleed to right edge.
* **Right Floating Sidebar (fixed)**
  * **Children:** Vertical stack of small white tool cards pinned to right edge: announcement, contact service, app download QR, close (X) button.
  * **Style Notes:** Compact, icon + 2-line label, subtle border/shadow, ~90px wide.

### 3. Data Presentation Style
* **Booking Form (primary data entry):** Vertical label-left field rows; text inputs with placeholder hints (pinyin/characters), icon suffix (location pin, calendar); swap control between paired fields; checkbox pair row; date field shows formatted date. Future runtime data: station names, dates — render as controlled input values, never hardcoded.
* **Hero carousel:** Dot-paginated slides; each slide combines background image + overlay headline + optional QR/CTA. Slide content should be data-driven (headline, image, link).
* **Promo grid:** Card-based; each card = title + tagline + description + illustration. Content should come from a promo/campaign data list.
* **Service icon row:** Icon grid pattern; items = icon + label + link, data-driven list.
* No tables/lists of records on this page; density is low-to-medium.

### 4. Interaction Surfaces
* **Primary:** Orange “查询” (search/query) full-width button in booking card — solid orange, white text, slight rounding, dominant CTA.
* **Secondary:**
  * Search bar button (blue, top header).
  * Trip-type tabs (one-way/round-trip/transfer/refund-change) — underline/active-text-blue style.
  * Left vertical tab rail on booking card — active = solid blue fill.
  * Nav dropdowns (carets), language selector, account dropdown.
  * Login / register links, checkbox toggles (student, high-speed rail), swap-origin button, date picker trigger.
  * Carousel dots.
  * Floating sidebar tools (announcement, contact, app QR, dismissible close).
* **Control style:** Flat design, minimal shadows, blue hover states for links, solid-fill active states for tabs, rounded ~4px inputs.

### 5. Frontend Requirements Summary
* **Must Preserve:**
  * Blue nav + orange CTA color system; centered ~1200px content column.
  * Booking card overlaying hero carousel, with left tab rail + top trip-type tabs + swap button + orange submit.
  * 2×2 pastel promo grid and quick-service icon strip with slash dividers.
  * Right-edge floating utility sidebar with close control.
  * Full-bleed hero with carousel dots.
* **Runtime-Driven Areas:** hero slides, promo card content, service icon list, station/date form values, carousel content, account/login state, language toggle — all data-driven.
* **Avoid:** Seeding UI with the screenshot's specific dates, headline copy, or banner imagery as fixed mock data; hardcoding promo text or station names into components.
